text:
No, next month's box won't be the Collector one. Plan changes made on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box. Next month's box was billed on the 25th at your current plan's price, and an already-billed box is still sent as is.

If you switch today, the Collector plan ($49/month, medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot) would start with the box after next month's. If you'd rather not wait, I can't promise an exception, but I can escalate your request to a Support Lead to see whether anything is possible.

To make the change, go to "Account" > "Subscriptions". There's no cancellation fee or minimum term for plan changes.
